title: Zhaolun Fan
text:
I am a PhD student at École Normale Supérieure – Paris Sciences et Lettres University.
I am a computational social scientist studying how social behavior vary across societies.
I use large-scale data to understand how individuals differ in seeing themselves as independent or as part of a group, and how these differences shape social networks and broader social patterns. I focus in particular on variation across East Asia and Western Europe.

title: About
text:
Research Summary
I study how social behavior varies across societies using large-scale historical and contemporary data. My work focuses on understanding how individuals differ in seeing themselves as independent or as part of a group, and how these differences shape social networks and broader social patterns. I examine these questions across East Asia and Western Europe.
